trap.label: claim × reclamar
trap.wrong: She claimed about the noise to the landlord.
trap.right: She complained about the noise to the landlord.
trap.why: Em português “reclamar” pode se traduzir por claim por semelhança com “reclamação”. Em inglês, claim é afirmar; reclamar de algo é complain.

mcq.q: An unproved accusation of a crime:
“Counsel ___ that the contract is void.” (argues a position)

opts: She claims to be an expert.

fix.right: Police alleged that he committed theft.
He asserted that he was innocent.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com allege: “Police say, without proof, that he stole.” (allege that)
Reescreva com claims: “The council says costs fell, but nobody checked.” (The council claims…)
Reescreva com asserted: “He firmly said he was innocent.”
rewrite.answer: He asserted that he was innocent.
